_note: Patterns are documented page-level compositions (docs pages + CSS sections + example screens). Registered in the pack as first-class artifacts; unlike components they do not carry a verify/states contract (recorded gap G-003).

patterns.title: Dashboard / overview
patterns.summary: Landing overview: hero metric strip, status/automation chips, recent-activity feed, follow-up cards.

patterns.title: Detail / record page
patterns.summary: Single-record page: page head with actions, fields, related lists, timeline.

patterns.title: Settings
patterns.summary: Task-sectioned settings cards with scoped partial saves.

patterns.title: Flow / automation builder
patterns.summary: Builder canvas for trigger → filter → action chains (node spine, insert-on-connector).

patterns.title: Dry-run / simulator report
patterns.summary: Two-column draft|report layout for previewing what an automated pipeline would do.

patterns.title: Stepper / wizard
patterns.summary: Multi-step task flow with step rail and per-step actions.

patterns.title: Index & eval queue
patterns.summary: Work-queue page: progress stats, per-item review rows, blind-labelling flow.
